meta.project: AI Business Assistant - Universal Voice Agent Booking System

product_overview: An intelligent AI-powered voice agent system automating appointment booking, order taking, and customer service calls for diverse businesses using OpenAI's Realtime API, calendar syncing, and comprehensive analytics.
core_goals: Increase booking conversion rate through 24/7 AI availability.
Enhance customer experience with instant, natural voice responses.
Automate calendar management and sending confirmations.
Provide actionable business insights through analytics and call logs.
key_features: Real-time AI Voice Agent with natural conversation, multi-language support, voice activity detection, and live transcription.
Complete Bookings Management including calendar and list views, filtering, status management, and Google Calendar integration.
Call History and Transcripts with full conversation logs, searchable transcripts, and outcome tracking.
Analytics Dashboard featuring revenue, booking, call performance, and customer insights with data visualization and export options.
Comprehensive Business Settings including AI configuration, services management, availability scheduling, and third-party integrations (Google Calendar, Twilio, Stripe).
Secure User Authentication and Account Management with Supabase Auth, password reset, and session handling.
Knowledge Base Management for AI contextual responses via website content crawling, summarization, and priority settings.
user_flow_summary: Customer interacts via Live Demo page or phone call; AI voice agent greets, provides info, checks calendar availability, books appointments, sends confirmation via email/SMS.
Business owner logs in, views and manages bookings, filters and updates statuses, and exports data as needed.
Owner configures AI instructions and knowledge base by adding websites, fetching content, summarizing, and saving for AI use.
Owner connects Google Calendar through OAuth, authorizes access, and syncs calendars with booking events.
Customer calls come through Twilio, triggering edge functions to create realtime AI sessions and handle conversations live.
validation_criteria: All core features fully functional without errors.
Authentication and authorization workflows verified with secured routes and session management.
Database schema migrations applied successfully with RLS policies enforced.
Google OAuth integration tested and tokens securely stored.
Knowledge Base fetch and summarization operations verified for accuracy.
Application build completes with passing automated tests (TestSprite).
Responsive UI verified on desktop and mobile devices.
Zero mock data; all data reflects real user inputs and system states.
Error and loading states handled gracefully throughout the app.
Performance meets targets for low-latency AI responses and real-time audio streaming.
